district_name: Lake Region Union Elementary-Middle School District

jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 603(a)(6)(G) inventory: Lake Region Union Elementary-Middle School District, a union elementary district (16 V.S.A. section 748) in the Orleans Central Supervisory Union (member towns: Albany, Barton, Brownington, Glover, Irasburg, Westmore, plus the former Orleans Incorporated School District area within Barton). Operational July 1, 2019; operates PK-8. A vote on merging this district with the Lake Region Union High School District into a proposed Orleans Central UUSD is scheduled November 3, 2026 -- pending, not the current structure.
Orleans Central Supervisory Union (official site; hosts both Lake Region districts' documents).

board.org_name: Lake Region Union Elementary-Middle School Board

sources.note: Lake Region Union Elementary-Middle School District: fourteen directors -- two per member area (Albany, Barton, Brownington, Glover, Irasburg, Westmore, and the former Orleans ISD area) -- elected by the whole district electorate at a single floor annual meeting with seats allocated by residency (16 V.S.A. section 748 modified at-large; March 9, 2026 warning, Article 6). Only the six members whose published terms run past March 2026 are minted; the eight seats whose terms expired in 2026 are HELD pending the March 9, 2026 annual meeting minutes and the March 30, 2026 reorganization minutes (per the OCSU Live Feed, the Albany, Westmore and Orleans seats were still unfilled after that meeting). Lake Region Union Elementary-Middle School District 2025-2026 Annual Report (official, via OCSU): board roster with "TERM EXPIRES" as published -- Albany: Neil Urie 2026, Dan Roock 2027; Barton: Freddi Very 2028, Jessica Torrence* 2026; Brownington: Debbie Brunelle 2027, Amber Hastings* 2026; Glover: Krista Mayer 2026, Sarah Elliott 2027; Irasburg: Tiffany Ovitt 2028, Brian Arant* 2026; Orleans: Samantha Johnson* 2026, Matthew Lapham* 2026; Westmore: Megan Valley 2027, Kalli Lafebvre 2026 (*appointed for 2025-2026). Its warning for the March 9, 2026 annual meeting (Article 6) elects eight directors by residency seat from the district's legal voters at a single floor meeting.

LRUEMSD 2024-2025 Annual Report (official): the prior-year roster corroborates the 2025 elections -- Very re-elected to 2028, Ovitt (appointed for 2024-2025) elected to 2028, and the vacant Glover seat filled by Sarah Elliott to 2027 per the 2025 warning's Glover two-year term; the OCSU Live Feed confirms the Albany, Westmore and Orleans seats were left unfilled at the March 9, 2026 meeting.
